content.title: About
content.content: Potato, scalloped, ready-to-heat is a single‑serve, fully cooked dish consisting of thinly sliced potatoes baked in a creamy cheese sauce with herbs and spices. The package is designed for quick preparation in a microwave or conventional oven.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The classic "scalloped potatoes" dish originated in English‑speaking cuisine in the 19th century.
Starchy varieties such as Russet are preferred for their fluffy texture when baked.
The sauce is typically made from milk, cream, and grated Cheddar cheese.
The frozen product can be stored for up to 12 months without loss of quality.
Microwave heating usually takes 3‑5 minutes, while oven heating requires 15‑20 minutes.

items.title: Rich in potassium
items.content: Potatoes provide potassium, which supports normal heart and muscle function.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains vitamin B6 and folate, important for metabolism.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates
items.content: Offers slowly digestible carbs that help maintain satiety.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: The cheese sauce adds calcium needed for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: Unlike many convenience meals, this product contains no added sugars.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: The creamy sauce and cheese make the dish relatively calorie‑dense; portion control is advised.

items.title: Contains dairy
items.content: Milk and cheese may trigger allergies or lactose intolerance in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Added salt increases sodium intake, which should be limited by people with hypertension.

items.title: Requires thorough heating
items.content: Insufficient heating can leave cold spots, increasing the risk of food‑borne illness.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the package in a microwave (800 W for about 4‑5 minutes) or in an oven at 180 °C for 15‑20 minutes until piping hot. Serve as a side dish with meat or fish, or enjoy it on its own, garnished with fresh herbs.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen product at –18 °C or lower. Once thawed, cook immediately and do not keep at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
